name: flame.usage-reports/capture.v1
description: Capture a daily or weekly core accounting report with its actual observation time and lower bound. Totals remain core-owned; saved reports are immutable.

name: flame.usage-reports/delete.v1
description: Remove one immutable saved report without changing core accounting evidence or totals.

name: flame.usage-reports/get.v1
description: Read one saved core report verbatim, preserving missing usage, unknown prices and recorded zeros.

name: flame.usage-reports/list.v1
description: List saved accounting report headers in capture order, newest first.
